cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've pulled the curtain up like you. Leave your desk and stand by the window until I say you can move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only wanted more light on the accounts. Why do I have to stand there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, better visibility. Stand where I can see you following the instruction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The window's open. I'm freezing; can I fetch my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch mine as well, then come back to the window and hold it for me.
